Мелисса.about: A mild herbal anxiolytic from the mint family. One of the few with RCT on cognition under acute stress.
Мелисса.caution: Caution with hypothyroidism - there is evidence of an effect on the thyroid gland in large doses. May interact with sedatives and thyroid medications.
Мелисса.food_sources: Used as a spice and in teas. Fresh leaves - in salads and drinks.
Мелисса.guidelines: EMA is included in traditional herbal medicines as an anxiolytic and for GI. EFSA health claims do not approve.
Мелисса.how_to_choose: Standardized extract for rosmarinic acid 4-6%. Or a whole leaf for tea - no worse.
Мелисса.myths: “Replaces sleeping pills” - no, the effect is mild. “Helps everyone with anxiety” - works mainly for situational anxiety, not for clinical disorders.
Мелисса.name: Lemon Balm
Мелисса.onset: 30-60 minutes for acute effect; 2-4 weeks for sustained reduction in anxiety.
Мелисса.title: Lemon Balm
Мелисса.upper_limit: There is no formal UL. High doses (above 3 g/day of extract) can affect the thyroid gland.
Мелисса.who_needs: People in stressful periods - exams, deadlines. For mild anxiety. Like evening tea before bed.
